name: Lyceum
short: European serverless and dedicated inference for open models over an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API, billed per token with prompt caching and no base fee.

plans.name: Serverless pay-as-you-go
plans.price: Per token, no base fee; e.g. GLM-5.3 $1.40 input / $4.40 output per 1M
plans.notes: 23 open models, OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, runs in European data centres.

plans.name: Dedicated endpoints
plans.notes: Reserved GPU capacity, model configuration and data-centre location agreed before launch.

plans.name: Prompt caching
plans.notes: Repeated prompt starts still in GPU memory are billed at the cached input price.
